quote: A driver shall not turn a vehicle from a direct course upon a highway unless and until such movement can be made with reasonable safety, and then only after giving a clearly audible signal by sounding the horn if any pedestrian may be affected by such movement and after giving an appropriate signal if any other vehicle may be affected by such movement.

activation.condition: Driver turns vehicle from a direct course on a highway.

obligation.description: Do not turn until reasonable safety; when a pedestrian may be affected sound a clearly audible horn, and when another vehicle may be affected give an appropriate signal.

timing.description: Safety and conditional signals precede the turn from a direct course.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original turn/body gap and context are retained; no legal safety cutoff.
Listener PCM and actuator request are separate observations; audibility requires physical review.
Retain original pedestrian body path and turn corridor; effect remains a judgment.
Retain Native indicator readback or original hand pose and source pixels; appropriateness remains unresolved.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: any other vehicle may be affected
judgment_calls_needed.note: Retain original vehicle body path and turn corridor; effect remains a judgment.
